title: Microsoft Agent Framework and Business Central MCP server
summary: The Business Central MCP server enables AI agents to connect to Business Central through the Microsoft Agent Framework. Pro-code developers can use the open-source Agent Framework combining Semantic Kernel and AutoGen to build .NET and Python agents that authenticate, connect to the MCP endpoint, and expose Business Central tools.
key_points: Business Central MCP server launched at Directions EMEA 2025 for connecting AI agents
Microsoft Agent Framework combines Semantic Kernel and AutoGen for building AI agents in .NET and Python
Integration requires three steps: setting up authentication, connecting to MCP endpoint, and creating the MCP plugin
Agents can access Business Central tools through the MCP server plugin initialized in the kernel

quotes.text: Business Central team launched the Business Central MCP server
quotes.why_it_matters: Marks the availability of official Business Central MCP server capability for agent integration
